meta.title: Release Depot
meta.description: Connects your npm and GitHub accounts inside DeepSeek Harness, then manages packages and releases from a neubrutalist workbench in the main panel: publish a local package to npm or GitHub Packages, push a directory and create a GitHub Release with the tarball attached, edit dist-tags, deprecate or unpublish versions, and review a local publish log. Also gives the agent five tools (release_status, npm_registry, npm_publish, github_publish, publish_package) that call the same operations. Open it with the Release Depot entry in the left sidebar, then sign in under Settings. Tokens are stored only in .dsh-release-depot/auth.json under your DSH home and are sent only to the registry and GitHub; nothing is uploaded to a third party. Publishing is a real, irreversible side effect, and npm versions cannot be overwritten; the panel requires a preflight before the final confirmation. Lifecycle build scripts (prepack/prepare) are not run; build before publishing. Provenance/attestation signing and npm token creation are not implemented, and the GitHub device flow targets github.com only.
